diagnostic_probe.note: Uses standalone dependency stubs; no claim of executable byte identity; separately pinned vector differential evidence is recorded in analysis/nemu-rsp-behavior.json. Per-function rebuilt extents apply only to this image hash.

codegen_hypothesis_checks.scope: Complete 101-function linked diagnostic probes; every canonical bank qualifier is preserved through byte and accumulator views. All variants remain scratch experiments, not promoted source.

findings.hypothesis: volatile vector/accumulator/flag banks, individually and in every combination
findings.result: Rejected: each nonempty qualifier combination regresses established functions, leaving78–88 matches; none of the8 outstanding functions becomes exact.

findings.hypothesis: natural vector union storage with U8/U16/U32 members, optionally U64
findings.result: No code change: both reproduce baseline93 matches and identical differences in all8 outstanding functions.

findings.hypothesis: explicit align8/align16 annotations on vector and accumulator globals or vector union type
findings.result: Rejected:81 matches, including12 regressions from established vector functions.
Rejected for this source: both helpers and93 established functions remain exact, but vector load/store move substantially further from original.

findings.hypothesis: WriteByte value parameter is signed byte,16-bit or32-bit integer
findings.result: Signed byte is indistinguishable; widening preserves standalone helper code but worsens vector store callers.

findings.hypothesis: Manual or macro-style 2/4/8-lane source expansion instead of ordinary compiler-unrolled loops
findings.result: No exact function in130 linked probes across all8 outstanding handlers. Four-lane arithmetic expansions often emit the same code as ordinary loops; multiply expansion contradicts the original one-lane backedge and substantially increases function size; VCL and memory expansions do not improve instruction structure. No source promoted.
findings.instruction_evidence: Original VADD/SUB/SUT contain four lane operations inside a two-iteration loop; VMAD/VMUL dispatcher retains one lane operation inside an eight-iteration loop. Literal eight-lane expansion also changes original variable shifts into immediate operations.

findings.hypothesis: Coherent volatile Instruction union view, or a whole volatile VCL high-bit local
findings.result: Rejected in five full-TU probes. Volatile Instruction regresses58 established functions (35/101 remain exact). Volatile high preserves the other93 but inhibits four-lane unrolling: VCL becomes a496-byte single-lane loop, with extra mandatory stack stores/loads absent from the original first lane. Current and closest near VCL source produce the same failure mode.
findings.instruction_evidence: Closest volatile-high candidate stores high to [esp+0x14] at function+0xe8, conditionally stores at+0x16f, then reloads at+0x173 and+0x186. Original first lane instead keeps high in EDI through its output flag shift.

source_inferences: Unsigned lane index and 16-bit flag-index conversions reproduce the original four-way loop and shift instructions; all indexes remain 0..15.
16-bit vector operands use signed integer promotions: sums 0..131070 and differences -65535..65535 fit 32 bits. This replaces unsigned arithmetic plus explicit signed reinterpretation.
Separate carry and zero values plus bitwise combination of Boolean 0/1 flags match the original SETG and Boolean instruction chain; there are no operand side effects.
The negated selected halfword produces the same stored low 16 bits; accumulator and destination writes are independent storage operations after operand reads.
Final extension-flag then carry-flag clearing follows the original relocation destinations.
remaining_differences: In the second and fourth unrolled lanes, original high-flag stack reloads occur separately inside both result arms; candidate hoists a single reload.
The second-lane flag shift/OR schedule and third/fourth-lane selector temporary register allocation remain different.
The candidate instruction body is 8 bytes shorter before alignment. Matching the 1472-byte public span is not a whole-function match.
vcl_reconstruction.limitation: Diagnostic DLL evidence does not prove final whole-program LTCG code or complete EXE byte equality.

source_inferences: The U32 loop counter is consistent with the recovered exact adjacent vector handlers and compiles to the observed countdown rather than signed compare.
The candidate restores the original 20-byte local frame and two-iteration/four-lane countdown in each function; full original 640-byte span then arises naturally.
Opcode locals use the declaration order found in exact VABS/VADDC/logic handlers. Selector offset and lane are explicit inside each lane loop, matching those recovered source forms.

For i=0..7 signedness does not change arithmetic or shifts. Bitwise selector regrouping is associative and equivalent. No saturating arithmetic, accumulator writes, or flag clearing changed. VSUT still clears only the low carry bit.
arithmetic_loop_reconstruction.source_ambiguity: Unsigned counter, opcode-local order and explicit inner selector locals are inferred from emitted structure and adjacent matching handlers; surviving instructions do not uniquely recover these original source spellings.
remaining_differences: All three routines remain instruction mismatches. Registers, PC update form, and carry/input scheduling still differ.
Candidate code including RET is 629 bytes versus 628 original, with standard linker alignment to 640; source contains no padding or artificial layout controls.
VSUT positional byte difference count increases 537 to 542; promotion rests on frame and loop structure, not count reduction.
arithmetic_loop_reconstruction.limitation: Diagnostic DLL evidence does not establish final whole-program LTCG allocation or complete EXE byte identity.
